calibration: Main house labelled approximately 12 x 19.3 metres in the exposé. Ground plan uses 12/434 metres per pixel in its 1888px-wide presentation. Site overview is registered using the same main-house width.
pool: Approximately 16 x 4 metres from the printed plan annotation; site placement follows the overview.

assumptions.mainRoofPitch: About 39 degrees, from the upper plan's 1.5 m and 2 m height lines and its 4.90 m maximum room height.
assumptions.externalWalls: About 0.45 m thick, growing inward from the cladding face, as drawn on the plans.
assumptions.basementRegistration: The basement sheet is drawn 20 px east of the ground sheet; the stair, light wells and footprint agree once shifted.
assumptions.heights: Inferred model values, not surveyed measurements.
assumptions.terrain: Level ground; no surveyed contours available.
assumptions.trees: Principal positions traced, crown shapes and heights illustrative.
assumptions.rooms: Photo-led furniture types, colours and arrangement, with approximate dimensions. Cutaway walls lowered for visibility.
assumptions.north: Plan north is 8.7° east of true north, from the house's outline in the Bavarian survey's LoD2 building models.
assumptions.planting: Photo-led meadow islands, mown paths and ornamental grass drifts. Bed boundaries, flower species and densities are illustrative.
assumptions.frontWall: Existing wall about 1.3 m high, visually estimated. Openings and boundary follow photo/plan registration; not surveyed.
assumptions.frontGarden: The garden between the parking bays and the granite well follows the grounds plan for its positions and the owner's photographs for the rest: a clipped hedge about 1.8 m high closing the parking's south and west edges with a path gap beside the guest wing, a gravel path to the well's brick circle, a timber trough beyond the well, a lower hedge behind it, four small fruit trees, shrubs and low perennials. Heights and species are visual estimates.
assumptions.upperRooms: Upper rooms follow the owner's photographs: plastered ceilings about 0.28 m below the roof slab, pale spruce rafters between the roof windows, trusses over the stair hall, plastered window reveals with rolled blinds, and on the east side a 0.55 m knee wall under a spruce sill with the lowest roof windows just above it. The build-up depth and knee-wall height are visual estimates.
assumptions.cars: A Porsche 911 Carrera GTS (992.2) and a Tesla Model Y Performance in the garage, built to published length, width, height, wheelbase and tyre sizes (911: 4,553 × 1,852 × 1,298 mm, wheelbase 2,450 mm, 245/35 ZR20 front and 315/30 ZR21 rear; Model Y: 4,796 × 1,921 × 1,611 mm, wheelbase 2,890 mm, track 1,636 mm front and 1,622 mm rear, 255/35 R21 front and 275/35 R21 rear). The 911's front track is the 992.2 Carrera figure (1,589 mm); its rear track (1,527 mm) is an estimate that keeps the 315 mm tyres inside the published width. Side and plan profiles are traced from manufacturer configurator photographs. Sources: Porsche newsroom, Type 992.2 911 GTS technical specifications; Tesla Model Y owner's manual, dimensions. Body surfaces are simplified; not a clearance survey.

state: Existing house. Renovations are not presented as existing or approved construction.

surfaceTextures.method: Tileable colour, roughness and relief sets generated by scripts/build-materials.mjs (deterministic noise and drawn boards, slates, planks, slabs, blades and leaves), projected in world space at true size. Each set's mean colour is set from the owner's photographs and checked by scripts/check-house-materials.mjs.
surfaceTextures.limitations: Board widths, slate courses, plank and slab sizes are read from the photographs, not measured. Textures reproduce character and colour, not the exact grain or wear of each surface.

mainAtrium.registration: Upper plan translated -52 px to align with the ground floor.
mainAtrium.bathroom: WC approximately 3.9 m² as labelled on the exposé; south entrance from the Diele. Fixture finishes illustrative, placement plan-derived.

photoInventory.note: The user recalled 203 uploads; 201 photographs are verifiable in both source library and portal. The source photographs inspected for textures are themselves 960–1280 pixels, not hidden high-resolution masters.

immersiveRealism.architecture: Plan-derived room layouts and owner corrections retained. Photo-led linen curtains, interior plaster faces, window reveals and hardware, fireplace hearth/logs, roof gutters/downpipes and ceiling slabs with the original registered atrium openings. Small dimensions and finishes remain interpretations. Roof windows now have physical holes through the detailed roof and tile layer. Roofs-on views include the upper gallery and furnishings using the same registered world transforms as the upper cutaway.
immersiveRealism.landscape: Distinct pine-like crowns and leafy trees, existing meadow islands and subtle motion. Distant tree line is an illustrative setting outside the traced lot, not a reconstruction of the horizon. The lot remains level. Beyond the setting, the land out to 150 km, the Alps included, stands at its true bearing and elevation angle from elevation data.
immersiveRealism.lighting: Daylight, overcast and evening are artistic lighting studies, not date- and location-calibrated sun studies. Interior exposure and warm fixture lights are chosen for visualization. Thin clear glazing uses non-occluding shadow rays in the photographic renderer; this is an architectural-glass approximation, not a physically exact glazing specification.
immersiveRealism.photographicRendering: Pinned three-gpu-pathtracer WebGL renderer; 8 light bounces, 12 transmissive bounces, progressive accumulation. Standard photo textures are rectified in the browser, with inferred roughness and normal maps. Default up to 1920 px / 256 samples; maximum 3840 px / 1024 samples. Panorama 2048×1024 or 4096×2048. Fine tree-leaf geometry is halved for export/rendering memory.
immersiveRealism.capture: PNG images, equirectangular panoramas, a 20-second silent orbit film where MediaRecorder is supported, and textured GLB of the currently visible scene and selected renovations. GLB export is a handoff for an offline renderer; no offline-rendered film or surveyed digital twin is claimed.
immersiveRealism.audio: Optional synthesized quiet garden ambience, not a recording from the property. Off by default.
immersiveRealism.limitations: Existing photos do not constitute a systematic photogrammetric capture. No Gaussian splat, scan-derived geometry, measured terrain or inferred unseen photograph has been presented as authentic.

entrancePathCorrection.source: Owner-provided four entrance photographs, 28 September 2026; existing site plan supplies the pedestrian gate and entrance door positions.
entrancePathCorrection.geometry: Broad apron removed north of the guest gable. Separate 1.35 m nominal cobbled walk from pedestrian gate to entrance link, with an approximately 85 mm shallow rise near the door. Width and rise are photo-derived estimates, not measured dimensions.
entrancePathCorrection.landscape: Wall-side soil and pale gravel drainage strip; deep ornamental grass island on the lawn side; timber bollards. Grass species and exact bed outlines are interpreted.
entrancePathCorrection.views: Shared geometry across both detail settings, floor views, photography and model export. Be here includes an entrance approach viewpoint.
entrancePathCorrection.driveway: Owner photo correction: same cobble material and bond on the vehicle apron and pedestrian walk, joining at the guest-wing corner. A tall-grass island separates the two toward the roadside wall; its outline is photo-derived.
entrancePathCorrection.roadsideInset: Owner-confirmed: cobbles cover the entire recessed forecourt between the road and separation wall, including the wedge-shaped ends. Shared between existing and proposed wall views.

landscapeSetting.limits: Tree positions and street furniture off the lot are photo-led interpretations; the woods' lower storey is drawn, not traced tree by tree. The distant land follows elevation data (Terrain Tiles: EU-DEM, DGM Österreich, SRTM) at about 50 m, drawn at compressed distances with true angles; level lake surfaces in that data are tinted as water. The house footprint and renovation geometry are unchanged.

poolSurround.confirmed: Pool recessed into lawn, weathered grey timber surround with boards perpendicular to each water edge, narrow pale rim.
poolSurround.modelAssumptions: 16 x 4 m retained from labelled plan. Deck width 0.48 m, rim 0.115 m, water 0.08 m below lawn and basin depth 1.4 m estimated, not measured.

alpineAtmosphere.geometry: The land out to 150 km from elevation data: 720 bearings by 64 distances, each keeping the steepest elevation angle in its cell, with the earth's curvature and standard refraction. Drawn 1–2.9 km away at true angles, centred under the camera, with baked atmospheric haze.
alpineAtmosphere.motion: GPU vertex breeze with distance falloff; uniform-driven pool ripples. Default on except reduced motion, 30 Hz maximum ambient updates with 20/15 Hz fallback based on render submission cost. Paused offscreen, in floor cutaways, and while preparing/refining photographs. Ambient frames reuse static shadow maps.

sunStudy.clock: Europe/Berlin, CET/CEST via Intl. Spring gap moves forward; autumn duplicate uses first occurrence.
sunStudy.method: NOAA/Meeus Julian-century solar declination and equation of time; refraction correction for apparent altitude. Source: https://gml.noaa.gov/grad/solcalc/calcdetails.html
sunStudy.limits: Model geometry and vegetation are estimates. Distant terrain does not cast sun-study shadows, and sunrise and sunset assume an unobstructed horizon. No measured irradiance, snow, or seasonal canopy model.
